name: investigation
description: Workflow for finding out why something behaves the way it does: gather repository context, track evidence, diagnose, and write findings down. Default workflow when a request carries no clear build or fix intent.

stages.purpose: Assemble the repository and session context the investigation will actually need.
Separate facts, assumptions, and unknowns from the start so the diagnosis rests on evidence.
Diagnose the actual cause systematically rather than settling on the first plausible explanation.
Write the findings down, including what was ruled out and why, so the next session does not repeat the work.

rules: Complete each stage before treating it as complete.
Label every claim as fact, assumption, or unknown; an unlabelled claim is treated as an assumption.
Attach each conclusion to the file, command, or test that proves it.
Do not fix anything in this workflow unless the request explicitly asks for a fix; the output is findings.
Do not claim verification that did not happen.
completion: The investigation is complete when the findings name the cause, cite the evidence for it, and list what remains unknown.
